title: Torres lurayirinaka
intro: Nayra tiemponjja, mä jachʼa civilización ukaw sartasïna, ukajj wali muspharkañ luräwinakapampi ukat wali muspharkañ chʼamanïtapampiw uñtʼayasïna. Aka entidad colectiva ukarux walja yänakampi ukhamarak jañchin ch’amanïñampiw churapxäna, ukampirus jupanakax mä thakhi ajllipxäna, jupanakar irpañatak khithatäki uka divin yatiyäwir jan yäqañataki. Jupanakan sarnaqäwipax sarnaqäwin anales ukanx mä jach’a yatichäwiwa, chiqa yatichäwinak jan iyawsañax kuna jan walt’awinakas utjaspa uk uñacht’ayi.
clues: Jachʼa chʼamanïñasa ukat jachʼa kankañsa churapjjetäna, janiw uka tiempon yaqha jaqenakat sipansa jukʼamp chʼamanïpkänti.
Sapa jachʼa cheqanakan jachʼa utanaka ukat jachʼa pilaranak lurasajj uñtʼatäpjjayätwa, wiñayatakiw jakapjjä sasaw amuyapjjerïta.
Jiwasanak taypit mä yatiyiriw khithatäna, jupar yatiyañataki, Allah saparukiw yupaychapxañajataki ukat idolonakas jaytañasatakiw jawsapxitu.
Jach’a jach’a tukusaw khithanitajarux jiskt’apxta, jupanakax Allah ukar yupaychañatakik jutapxitu ukat kuntix nayra achachilanakajax yupaychapkän uk jaytañatakik jutapxitu sasaw jiskt’apxta.
Uraqisax huertanakampi, uma jalsunakampi, suma yapunakampi phuqantatänwa, ukampis chʼamasatakiw sum jakasipxta sasaw sapxirïta, janiw Luririsarjamakiti.
Jan jaytjasisa ukat sawkasiñajatjja, qhepatjja, mä ajjsarkañ, wali colerat thayampiw tʼunjapjjetäna, uka thayajj walja urunak arumaw wal thaytʼanïna.

arabic: فَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا۟ مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً ۖ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ
verse: As for ʿAad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allāh who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs. (41:15)
